name_zh: 梅内姆/阿根廷/货币板/私有化/赦免/里奥哈/卡洛斯/可兑换
description_zh: 卡洛斯·梅内姆 (1930-) 阿根廷总统 (1989-1999) 推行货币局制度，实现货币稳定和可兑换性，实施大规模私有化改革和赦免政治，结束了危机，但也埋下了经济危机种子，被誉为'里奥哈家族'总统。
description_en: Carlos Menem (1930-) Argentine President (1989-1999) implemented currency board system, achieved monetary stability and convertibility, conducted large-scale privatization reforms and pardon politics, ended crisis but also planted seeds for economic crisis, known as 'Laioha family' president.
reason_zh: 梅内姆代表了拉美如何通过货币稳定和私有化改革结束危机，但也如何货币政策错误埋下经济灾难的教训，体现了新自由主义改革的复杂性。
reason_en: Menem represents how Latin American ends crisis through currency stability and privatization reforms, but plants seeds for economic disaster through currency policy errors, embodies complexity of neo-liberal reforms.
